# routeros_app_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `app_store_urls` (String) Comma separated list of custom app store URLs. Every URL must point to a YAML array in which each element describes one application.
- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether applications are updated automatically when a new container image is published.
- `disk` (String) Name of the disk from `/disk` that stores the container images and the application data, or `none`.
- `download_path` (String) Directory used for downloads by the applications. When it is not set RouterOS derives one from `disk` and reports it in `assumed_download_path`.
> RouterOS does not report this property back, so its value is kept from the configuration and cannot be refreshed from the device.
- `lan_bridge` (String) Name of the bridge that represents the local network for applications attached to the `lan` network, or `none`.
- `media_path` (String) Directory used for media files by the applications. When it is not set RouterOS derives one from `disk` and reports it in `assumed_media_path`.
> RouterOS does not report this property back, so its value is kept from the configuration and cannot be refreshed from the device.
- `registry_mirrors` (String) Comma separated list of container registry mirrors used when pulling images.
- `router_ip` (String) Address at which the router itself is reachable by the applications and by the users of their web interfaces.
- `show_in_webfig` (Boolean) Whether the links to the enabled applications are shown on the WebFig login page.

### Read-Only

- `assumed_download_path` (String) Download directory that is actually used, either taken from `download_path` or derived from `disk`.
- `assumed_media_path` (String) Media directory that is actually used, either taken from `media_path` or derived from `disk`.
- `certificate` (String) Name of the certificate that is used for the HTTPS URLs of the installed applications.
- `certificate_status` (String) State of the application certificate.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
